name: keypedia
description: FDA 483s, warning letters, inspections and KRA risk scores from KeyPedia, inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
KeyPedia is a regulatory intelligence platform for quality, regulatory and audit teams in life sciences. The KeyPedia plugin brings its data into ChatGPT, so you can research suppliers and manufacturers without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Check a company: FDA Form 483 observations, warning letters, inspection history and outcomes, with the source document behind every answer.
- Screen a supplier list: paste supplier names; KeyPedia matches each to the right facility and ranks the list by KRA risk score.
- Use KRA (KeyPedia Risk Assessment): a red, yellow or green risk tier for every scored facility, with the percentile and the main reasons, plus a combined view for a group of companies.
- Read the evidence: short excerpts and numbered observations from FDA documents.
- Count and compare: totals and trends by record type, month, company, office or violation.
- Keep watch: list your KeyPedia saved searches, see what changed, run them, and, if you allow it, save new searches or share them by link.

Coverage includes US FDA records and inspections, plus EMA, UK MHRA, Health Canada, Brazil ANVISA, China NMPA, the Orange Book and more, limited to the datasets your KeyPedia account can access.

Sign in with your existing KeyPedia account. The plugin reads by default. Saving and sharing searches is a separate permission that is off unless you tick it when you connect. Nothing is ever deleted.

Tell me about Pfizer and its KRA risk score.
How many FDA 483s were issued each month this year?

positive.description: Describe what the plugin can do for this account
positive.prompt: What can the KeyPedia plugin do?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the datasets available to the test account (US FDA records and others) and the kinds of questions it can answer.

positive.prompt: Show me recent FDA warning letters.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of recent FDA warning letters with company names and issue dates, newest first.

positive.description: Company profile with KRA risk score
positive.prompt: Tell me about Pfizer and its KRA risk score.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Pfizer, summarizes its FDA record and gives its KRA risk tier (red, yellow or green) with the main reasons.

positive.prompt: How many FDA 483s were issued each month this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a count of FDA Form 483 records for each month of the current year.

positive.description: Save a search and share it (write permission)
positive.prompt: Save a search for FDA warning letters from this year and give me a share link.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the search to the test account, then returns a https://www.keypedia.com/dashboard?saved=... link that opens it. Requires the 'Save and share searches for you' permission ticked when connecting.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Boston today?

negative.description: Unsupported deletion: the plugin has no delete tool and must not delete anything
negative.prompt: Delete all my KeyPedia saved searches.

negative.description: Unrelated creative request: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
